messages:
Maya: FYI going to do a gate-check for TempestXL-13b bring-up. Need a focused perf/quant triage before we greenlight model onboarding. Main asks: quick quant smoke (int8 + int4), batching sweep (bs 1,4,8,16), ctx sweep (64,512,2048), and a small regression eval vs Aurora11b on our NLU suite. Trying to keep this to a single-day spike. :eyes:
Raj: SGTM. Prioritize by customer impact — do latency-sensitive configs first (bs 1/4 at 64/512). I'll own the quant smoke. Assign Sophia for regression eval and dataset prep. Chris can do batching heatmap + cost estimates.
Sophia: I'll assemble a 1k prompt slice (mix of chat, QA, completion) from prod-evals as the signal set. Quick Q: do we want top-p detokenization disabled during perf runs? (keep decoding deterministic)
Chris: yes, disable sampling. Set `--temperature 0 --top_p 1` for perf/latency runs. Also target SLO: p95 < 1200ms for bs=1 @64 ctx on GGX-4. Cost target: model should not exceed 1.5x Aurora11b token cost on avg.
Maya: checklist I'm thinking: 1) quant smoke int8/int4 (latency + small convqa quality), 2) ctx sweep 64/512/2048 throughput/kv-hit profiling, 3) batching sweep heatmap, 4) regression eval vs Aurora11b (accuracy + hallucination), 5) warmup script + priming strategy. Anyone add/remove?
Raj: add: KV cache memory profile and peak-GPU-ram for 2k ctx. Also include a quick all-close fallback plan if int4 quality regresses >3 pts.
Sophia: noted. I'll produce a CSV with format: prompt_id, input_len, gold, aurora_answer, tempestxl_answer, exact_match, rougeL, halluc_flag. Will upload to s3://redwood-evals/tempestxl/gatecheck/ by EOD.
Chris: bench CLI I'll run (example):
```bash
redwood-bench run --model tempestxl-13b-lite --quant int8 --ctx 512 --batch 4 --decoding "temp=0 top_p=1" --out /tmp/tempest_bench.json
```
Also will run `--warmup 50 --continuous_batching on` and then a `--warmdown 10` to measure stable tail latency.
bench-bot: quick smoke (auto): tempestxl int8 bs=1 ctx=64 p95=780ms p99=1100ms throughput=28 tok/s peak_mem=12.4GB -- quality delta vs aurora11b on 50 sample: EM -1.2 pts ROUGE -0.8 pts.
Maya: thanks bench-bot — that's promising for int8. Raj please run the int4 smoke but keep an eye on halluc_flag. If int4 drops >3 EM points we gate it.
Raj: running int4 now, will post raw logs. ETA ~45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sophia: once you have int4 logs, I'll run the regression diff tool and post a short summary (pass/fail + top regressions).
Chris: I'll start the batching grid overnight and push a heatmap to the bench dashboard. If anyone needs a quick config tweak ping me:@chris
Maya: final note — capture token-per-second and cost-per-token metrics in bench output. If anyone hits flaky tails, add a `--profile_kv` flag. I'll do a quick sync tomorrow 10:30am to decide go/no-go. :calendar:
